messages.text: Run the deferred capability check after the frontend lane lands: `pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/history.spec.ts` (second diagnosis from the first, comparison with arrow and text, archive/restore confirming and cancelling with ConfirmDialog, no comparison offered for the first diagnosis). Then the full `pnpm test` and `pnpm test:e2e`. Use `pnpm exec vitest run <files>` for a focused vitest run, because `pnpm test -- <files>` ignores the file filter.

IF-005 as implemented was checked against the code and matches: GET /api/companies/:id/timeline -> { draft: TimelineDraft | null, completed: TimelineEntry[], archived: TimelineEntry[] } (newest first). POST /api/diagnoses/:id/archive and /restore return TimelineEntry and are idempotent; a draft gives 409 diagnosis_not_completed, an unknown id 404 diagnosis_not_found. GET /api/diagnoses/:id/comparison gives 409 no_previous_diagnosis for the first diagnosis. The recalculated block is present only when the versions differ.

Recalculation uses the rules injected into createApp (currently rulesV1 by default; the v2 fixture in tests). Only two rules versions exist today, so this is correct. If three or more versions ever exist, a previous diagnosis frozen with an intermediate version is recalculated with the current rules. That will need a registry of historical Rules by version.
